name: Theta Validation Suite
description: Executable conformance cases for the installable components in ThetaIDE Basics.

components.title: CartPole live environment
components.description: The Basic Suite environment must expose an online-RL CartPole environment.

components.title: SB3 PPO algorithm
components.description: PPO must retain its SB3 engine, algorithm identity, and online-RL capability declaration.

components.title: d3rlpy CQL algorithm
components.description: CQL must retain its d3rlpy engine, algorithm identity, and offline-RL capability declaration.

components.title: DNN model
components.description: The Basic Suite DNN must expose its architecture configuration.

components.title: Tabular data module
components.description: The data-loader adapter must remain independently configurable from a dataset environment.

cases.title: Online smoke recipe
cases.description: A minimal online-RL recipe using Basic Suite PPO, DNN, and CartPole must execute successfully.

cases.title: Missing method is blocked
cases.description: An online-RL recipe that omits its required method must be stopped before training begins.
cases.blocked_reason: The online-RL method contract requires an algorithm and model.

cases.title: Method without a model is blocked
cases.description: A method that names an algorithm but omits its model must not launch.
cases.blocked_reason: Every method requires a model architecture.

cases.title: Offline CQL in online RL is blocked
cases.description: The suite must reject an offline-only algorithm when an online-RL recipe selects it.
cases.blocked_reason: CQL declares compatibility with offline RL only.
